final: WITH inv AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country AS Country, (SELECT AVG(il.UnitPrice) FROM InvoiceLine il WHERE il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId) AS avg_price FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId), dev AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, avg_price - (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM inv) AS deviation FROM inv), fin AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, deviation, deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS dev_minus_country_avg FROM dev), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY dev_minus_country_avg DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM fin) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, deviation, dev_minus_country_avg FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY dev_minus_country_avg DESC NULLS LAST, InvoiceId
